OrderStatus.description: Displays order status for the Order drop-in.

onError.description: Callback when order search fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

OrderSearch.description: The `OrderSearch` container enables order searches using email, last name, and order number. It is available to both guest and registered users for quick access to order details.

onSuccess.description: Callback when the return request is submitted successfully. Use to redirect users, show confirmation, or trigger follow-up flows.

onError.description: Callback when the return request fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

CreateReturn.description: The `CreateReturn` container manages the creation of return requests. It supports custom return attributes and configurable validation through the Adobe Commerce Admin. This container consists of three sequential screens that guide users through the item return process:

OrderHeader.description: Displays order header for the Order drop-in.

CustomerDetails.description: The `CustomerDetails` container organizes customer and order information into the following sections:

OrderCancelForm.description: The `OrderCancelForm` container provides a cancellation form that allows users to select reasons for canceling an order and perform the cancellation operation.

OrderCostSummary.description: The `OrderCostSummary` container displays detailed order costs on the Order Details and Return Details pages. It includes the following sections:

OrderProductList.description: The `OrderProductList` container displays a list of products associated with a specific order or return. Each item in the list is represented by a product card containing details such as the price, applied discounts, tax information, final amount, and product attributes.

OrderReturns.description: The `OrderReturns` container displays the list of returns associated with a specific order. Each return is presented with relevant details, such as return status and associated items. If no returns have been created for the order, the container is not rendered, ensuring that the interface remains clean and free of unnecessary placeholders.

ReturnsList.description: The `ReturnsList` container displays a complete list of all created returns available to the user. Each return card follows the same structure as the `OrderReturns` container, allowing consistent presentation of return details. It provides an overview of all return requests, enabling users to manage and track their status in one place.

ShippingStatus.description: The `ShippingStatus` container displays information about shipments, including product images, the delivery service used, and tracking numbers. A separate block is rendered for each shipment created for the order. It also lists products that have not yet been shipped, providing a clear overview of the shipping status for all items.
